name: agentic-pom
description: AI-agent-driven Playwright Page Object generator. Point pw-crawl at a URL and get back typed page-object code, navigation helpers, and an API-dependency manifest.

scripts.install:all: for dir in apps/vanilla-html apps/react-app apps/vue-app apps/angular-app apps/svelte-app apps/nextjs-app apps/lit-app; do echo "Installing $dir..." && (cd $dir && npm install); done
scripts.start:all: npm run generate-shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names vanilla,react,vue,angular,svelte,next,lit "npm start --prefix apps/vanilla-html" "npm start --prefix apps/react-app" "npm start --prefix apps/vue-app" "npm start --prefix apps/angular-app" "npm start --prefix apps/svelte-app" "npm start --prefix apps/nextjs-app" "npm start --prefix apps/lit-app" "node scripts/wait-for-apps.mjs"

author: Rashad Colebrooke
